semantics.evidence: problem.txt: Mealy-type FSM recognizes 101; only 3 states; overlapping sequences; negative edge asynchronous reset; sequential logic on positive clock edge
semantics.sampling: State consumes x on each posedge clk when aresetn is high.
semantics.output: Combinational z is high exactly when the consumed history ends in 10 and current x is 1; no output register or added latency.
semantics.overlap: After consuming a completing 1, retain suffix 1.
semantics.reset: negedge aresetn asynchronously clears history; held-low reset clears state at each posedge; reset release does not consume x.
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization is specified; behavior is checked after reset.

numeric.state_encoding: Three states in a two-bit enum

verification.oracle: Independent two-bit sampled input history and valid-history count, grounded in sequence 101
verification.phases: Check before and after rising edges and on input changes between edges
verification.cases: All 256 eight-bit strings, directed overlap, repeated ones and zeros, asynchronous reset during partial and detected sequence, held reset
verification.evaluation: python3 dev_check.py --label initial; bounded self-checking dev_tb

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before any reset is unspecified; no deterministic startup output is required or tested.
